decks.notes: The main focus of this UW Control deck is to control the game through various counter-spells, board wipes, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering key spells, removing threats from the board, and drawing cards to maintain control of the game. The deck also features powerful win conditions such as Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Dream Trawler to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. The mana base is designed to support the deck's control elements while providing the necessary colors for its spells.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of aggressive spirit creatures and disruptive spells to put pressure on the opponent and control the game. The deck aims to quickly establish a board presence with efficient creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Spectral Sailor, while also disrupting the opponent's plans with cards like Spell Queller and Shacklegeist. The inclusion of Curious Obsession provides card draw and extra damage, while the land base allows for consistent mana production. Overall, the deck focuses on maintaining tempo and overwhelming the opponent with a fast and disruptive aggro strategy.

This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on applying early pressure with efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provide additional threats and graveyard recursion to help maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to close out games quickly through a combination of creature damage and targeted removal spells, utilizing the powerful synergy of black and red cards in Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to trigger powerful abilities from cards like Mayhem Devil and Witch's Oven. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn while generating value through sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Bloodtithe Harvester. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion to add consistency to the deck. The deck also includes card draw options like Thoughtseize and Deadly Dispute to maintain card advantage and pressure the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells.

The main concept of this deck is to maximize devotion to green through aggressive plays and mana ramping with cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. By using cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Karn, the Great Creator, the deck aims to generate value and maintain board presence. The inclusion of cards like Storm the Festival and Cavalier of Thorns allows for explosive plays, while cards like Old-Growth Troll and Polukranos Reborn provide solid threats on the battlefield. The deck also utilizes cards like Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures to further enhance its strength in a Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

Utilizing a combination of mana acceleration and powerful green creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a high devotion to green strategy. By ramping into large threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll, as well as utilizing cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator to generate advantage, this deck seeks to establish board presence quickly and maintain pressure throughout the game. Additionally, the inclusion of Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Boseiju, Who Endures provides additional utility and resilience in order to secure victory in the early turns of the game.

The deck focuses on aggressively filling the board with creatures and disrupting the opponent's strategy with hand disruption spells. It features powerful threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, supported by removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill. The deck also includes versatile cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to maintain pressure on the opponent. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruption spells, this Rakdos Aggro deck aims to overwhelm and outpace the opponent in a fast-paced Pioneer 1 vs 1 match.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice synergies with cards like Witch's Oven, Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Fatal Push to control the board and deal consistent damage.
